Valid values are `\"commonjs\"`, `\"module\"`, `\"module-typescript\"` and `\"commonjs-typescript\"`. The `\"-typescript\"` values are not available with the flag `--no-strip ... types`. The default is no value, or `\"commonjs\"` if `--no-experimental-detect-module` is passed.\n\n---\n\nTitle: Modules: ECMAScript modules | Node.js v26.10.0 Documentation\nURL: https://nodejs.org/api/esm.html\nPublished: N/A\nAuthor: N/A\nHighlights:\nModules: ECMAScript modules | Node.js v26.12.0 Documentation\n...\n| Version | Changes |\n| --- | --- |\n| v23.1.0, v22.12.0, v20.18 ... 3, v18.20.5 | Import attributes are no longer experimental. |\n| v22.0.0 | Drop support for import assertions. |\n| v21.0.0, v20.10.0, v18.20.0 | Add experimental support for import attributes. |\n| v20.0.0, v18.19.0 | Module customization hooks are executed off the main thread. |\n| v18.6.0, v16.17.0 | Add support for chaining module customization hooks. |\n| v17.1.0, v16.14.0 | Add experimental support for import assertions. |\n| v17.0.0, v16.12.0 | Consolidate customization hooks, removed `getFormat`, `getSource`, `transformSource`, and `getGlobalPreloadCode` hooks added `load` and `globalPreload` hooks allowed returning `format` from either `resolve` or `load` hooks. |\n| v15.3.0, v14.17.0, v12.22.0 | Stabilize modules implementation. |\n| v14.13.0, v12.20.0 | Support for detection of CommonJS named exports. |\n| v14.8.0 | Unflag Top-Level Await. |\n| v14.0.0, v13.14.0, v12.20.0 | Remove experimental modules warning. |\n| v13.2.0, v12.17.0 | Loading ECMAScript modules no longer requires a command-line flag. |\n| v12.0.0 | Add support for ES modules using `.js` file extension via `package.json` `\"type\"` field. |\n...\nAuthors can tell Node.js to interpret JavaScript as an ES module via the `.mjs` file extension, the `package.json` `\"type\"` field with a value `\"module\"`, or the `--input-type` flag with a value of `\"module\"`. These are explicit markers of code being intended to run as an ES module.\n...\nthe `.cjs` ... `\"commonjs ... `, or the `-- ... `\"commonjs\"`.\n\nWhen code lacks explicit markers for either module system, Node.js will inspect the source code of a module to look for ES module syntax. Return\n\n---\n\nTitle: Command-line API | Node.js v16.16.0 Documentation\nURL: https://nodejs.org/download/release/v16.16.0/docs/api/cli.html\nPublished: N/A\nAuthor: N/A\nHighlights:\n- The program was started with a command-line flag that forces the entry point to be loaded with ECMAScript module loader.\n- The file has an`.mjs` extension.\n- The file does not have a`.cjs` extension, and the nearest parent`package.json` file contains a top-level\"type\" field with a value of`\"module\"`.\n...\nWhen loading ECMAScript module loader loads the program entry point, the`node` command will only accept as input only files with`.js`,`.mjs`, or`.cjs` extensions; and with`.wasm` extensions when`--experimental-wasm-modules` is enabled.\n...\n#### -c, --check#\n...\n| Version | Changes |\n| --- | --- |\n| v10.0.0 | The`--require` option is now supported when checking a file. |\n| v5.0.0, v4.2.0 | Added in: v5.0.0, v4.2.0 |\n\nSyntax check the script without executing.","type":"text"}],"isError":false}
